description_en: Describes the configurations of file shares on a file gateway
description_zh: 获取文件网关上共享的配置信息
name: DescribeGatewayFileShares

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. If you leave this parameter empty, the configurations of all file shares on the gateway are returned
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享的ID。如果该字段为空，则枚举该网关上的所有文件共享的配置信息
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly refresh the cache. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制刷新缓存。默认值：false
parameters.name: refresh

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

AccessBasedEnumeration.description_en: Indicates whether access-based enumeration is enabled
AccessBasedEnumeration.description_zh: 是否基于访问权限的枚举

Address.description_en: The internal IP address of the share in the VPC

BeLimit.description_en: The maximum upload speed. A value of 0 indicates no limit. Unit: B/s
BeLimit.description_zh: 最大上传速度。0代表无限制。单位：B/s

BindIPAddr.description_en: The mount IP address bound to the share

Browsable.description_en: Indicates whether the share is browsable

BucketsStub.description_en: Indicates whether multi-bucket aggregation is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
BucketsStub.description_zh: 是否已启用多Bucket聚合。false表示未启用

BypassCacheRead.description_en: Indicates whether the feature of directly reading from OSS is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
BypassCacheRead.description_zh: 是否已启用直读OSS功能。false表示未启用

CacheMode.description_en:
The cache mode of the file share. Valid values:

Cache: cache mode.

Sync: replication mode
CacheMode.description_zh:
文件共享缓存模式。可能值：
Cache：缓存模式。
Sync：复制模式

DiskId.description_en: The ID of the cache disk that corresponds to the file share. This parameter is returned only for online gateways
DiskId.description_zh: 文件共享对应缓存盘的ID。仅线上网关返回该值

DownloadLimit.description_en: The maximum download speed. A value of 0 indicates no limit. Unit: B/s
DownloadLimit.description_zh: 最大下载速度。0代表无限制。单位：B/s

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the share is enabled

ExpressSyncId.description_en: The ID of the express synchronization group

FastReclaim.description_en: Indicates whether upload optimization is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
FastReclaim.description_zh: 是否已启用上传优化功能。false表示未启用

FeLimit.description_en: The maximum write speed. A value of 0 indicates no limit. Unit: B/s
FeLimit.description_zh: 最大写入速度。0代表无限制。单位：B/s

FileNumLimit.description_en: The number of files that the file system supports
FileNumLimit.description_zh: 文件系统支持的文件数目

FsSizeLimit.description_en: The capacity of the file system. Unit: B

IgnoreDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the ignore deletions feature is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
IgnoreDelete.description_zh: 是否已启用忽略删除功能。false表示未启用

InRate.description_en: The rate at which data is written to the cache. Unit: B/s

IndexId.description_en: The ID of the file share

KmsRotatePeriod.description_en: The key rotation period. Unit: seconds
KmsRotatePeriod.description_zh: 密钥轮转周期。单位为秒

LocalPath.description_en: The internal device name of the cache disk

MnsHealth.description_en:
The health status of the message queue. Valid values:

TopicAndQueueFailure: The message topic and queue are inaccessible.

TopicFailure: The message topic is inaccessible.

MNSFullSyncInit: A full synchronization is pending.

MNSFullSyncing: A full synchronization is in progress.

QueueFailure: The message queue is inaccessible.

MNSNotEnabled: Express synchronization is disabled.

MNSHealthy: The synchronization is normal
MnsHealth.description_zh:
消息队列健康状态。可能值：
TopicAndQueueFailure: 消息队列消息主题无法访问。
TopicFailure: 消息主题无法访问。
MNSFullSyncInit: 全量同步等待中。
MNSFullSyncing: 全量同步进行中 。
QueueFailure: 消息队列无法访问。
MNSNotEnabled: 极速同步未开启。
MNSHealthy: 同步正常

NfsV4Optimization.description_en: Indicates whether NFSv4 optimization is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
NfsV4Optimization.description_zh: 是否已启用NFS V4优化。false表示未启用

NoPartition.description_en: Indicates whether a partition exists. A value of true indicates that no partition exists

ObsoleteBuckets.description_en: The buckets that are being removed from the multi-bucket aggregation

OssBucketRegionId.description_en: The region where the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket of the file share is located
OssBucketRegionId.description_zh: 文件共享对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket所在地域

OssBucketSsl.description_en: Indicates whether an SSL connection is used to access the OSS bucket

OssEndpoint.description_en: The endpoint used to access the OSS bucket

OssHealth.description_en:
The health status of the OSS bucket. Valid values:

BucketHealthy: The OSS connection is normal.

BucketAccessDenied: The OSS access permissions are abnormal.

BucketMiscFailure: Other OSS access exceptions occurred.

BucketNetworkFailure: An OSS network access exception occurred.

BucketNotExist: The OSS bucket does not exist.

Empty: The status is unknown
OssHealth.description_zh:
OSS Bucket的健康状态。可能值：
BucketHealthy：OSS连接正常。
BucketAccessDenied : OSS访问权限异常。
BucketMiscFailure： OSS访问其他异常。
BucketNetworkFailure： OSS访问网络异常。
BucketNotExist： OSS Bucket不存在。
什么都没返回：未知

OssUsed.description_en: The amount of data in the cloud. Unit: B

PartialSyncPaths.description_en: The group of directory paths in partial replication mode. This parameter is in the JSON format
PartialSyncPaths.description_zh: 部分复制模式下，目录路径组，JSON格式

Protocol.description_en:
The type of the share. Valid values:

SMB

NFS
Protocol.description_zh:
共享类型。可能值：
SMB。
NFS

RemainingMetaSpace.description_en: The remaining metadata space. Unit: B
RemainingMetaSpace.description_zh: 可使用元数据空间。单位：B

RemoteSync.description_en: Indicates whether remote sync is enabled. A value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
RemoteSync.description_zh: 是否已启用反向同步。false表示未启用

RemoteSyncDownload.description_en: Indicates whether to download file data during a remote sync
RemoteSyncDownload.description_zh: 反向同步下是否下载文件数据

RoClientList.description_en: The list of read-only clients. This parameter is returned when Protocol is set to NFS
RoClientList.description_zh: 只读客户端列表。当Protocol为NFS时返回

RoUserList.description_en: The list of read-only users. This parameter is returned when Protocol is set to SMB
RoUserList.description_zh: 只读用户列表。当Protocol为SMB时返回

RwClientList.description_en: The list of read-write clients. This parameter is returned when Protocol is set to NFS
RwClientList.description_zh: 读写客户端列表。当Protocol为NFS时返回

RwUserList.description_en: The list of read-write users. This parameter is returned when Protocol is set to SMB
RwUserList.description_zh: 读写用户列表。当Protocol为SMB时返回

State.description_en:
The file synchronization status. Valid values:

clean: The synchronization is complete.

dirty: The synchronization is incomplete
State.description_zh:
文件同步状态。可能值：
clean：同步完成。
dirty：同步未完成

Status.description_en:
The status of the share. Valid values:

started

stopped
Status.description_zh:
共享的启停状态。可能值：
started
stopped

SupportArchive.description_en: Indicates whether transparent reading of archived files is supported
SupportArchive.description_zh: 是否支持归档透明读取

SyncProgress.description_en:
The progress of the full synchronization.

This parameter is valid only when the share is added to a synchronization group. It indicates the progress of the full synchronization, from 0 to 100.

-2: indicates that the gateway version does not support this feature.

-1: indicates that no full synchronization has occurred
SyncProgress.description_zh:
全量同步进度。
当共享已加入同步组的情况下，该返回参数有效， 表明共享全量同步进度(0 ~ 100)。
-2：表示共享所在网关版本不支持该功能。
-1：表示共享并未发生全量同步

Throttling.description_en: Indicates whether throttling is enabled for the share. A value of false indicates that throttling is disabled
Throttling.description_zh: 共享是否限流。false表示未限流

TotalDownload.description_en: The total amount of data downloaded from the OSS bucket to the gateway. Unit: B
TotalDownload.description_zh: 从OSS Bucket到网关总下载量。单位：B

TotalUpload.description_en: The total amount of data uploaded from the gateway to the OSS bucket. Unit: B
TotalUpload.description_zh: 从OSS Bucket到网关总上传量。单位：B

TransferAcceleration.description_en: Indicates whether transfer acceleration is enabled

Used.description_en: The used cache space. Unit: B

WindowsAcl.description_en: Indicates whether support for Windows Access Control Lists (ACLs) is enabled

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果。返回值如下：
true：请求成功。                                
false：请求失败
